replacements.from: 'Logic Adapters allow Redstone Control for Reactors.'

replacements.from: 'With two, you can set up a Fail Safe that can shut off the Reactor under certain conditions.'

replacements.from: 'When the Reactor has Critical Damage, it will give off a redstone signal.'

replacements.from: 'We can use this to activate a piston with gravel or sand on it to activate an Observer.'

replacements.from: 'This is an Oberserver facing towards the Gravel. The Gravel will activate it and turn off the reactor.'

replacements.from: 'To activate the Fusion Reactor, we will need a few things.'
replacements.to: '要启动聚变反应堆，我们需要准备几样东西。'

replacements.from: 'You will need to put a Hohlraum filled with D-T fuel in the Controller.'
replacements.to: '需在控制器中放入一个装有D-T燃料的黑体辐射腔。'

replacements.from: 'You will need to shoot 400MRF using Lasers into the Laser Matrix.'
replacements.to: '需使用激光向激光聚焦矩阵射入4亿MRF能量。'

replacements.from: 'The Laser Amplifier needs to have the Red face pointing towards the Matrix.'
replacements.to: '激光增幅器需将红色面朝向矩阵。'

replacements.from: "You will also need to give the Reactor fuel."
replacements.to: "你还需要为反应堆提供燃料。"

replacements.from: 'The Reactor mixes the D-T fuel at a set rate when they are pumped in separately.'
replacements.to: '当D-T燃料被分别泵入时，反应堆将以设定速率进行混合。'

replacements.from: 'The Fusion Reactor can be used to generate millions of RF per tick.'
replacements.to: '聚变反应堆可用于每刻生成数百万RF能量。'

replacements.from: 'Ports Can Be Changed Using A Configurator'
replacements.to: '端口可使用配置器进行更改'

replacements.from: 'The Fusion Reactor is built using this pattern for each face.'
replacements.to: '聚变反应堆需按此结构逐面搭建。'

replacements.from: 'You will need a port for exporting power.'
replacements.to: '你需要一个用于输出电力的端口。'

replacements.from: 'The Laser Matrix is used to kickstart the reactor.'
'The Fusion Reactor Controller must be placed in the middle of the top face.'
replacements.to: '聚变堆控制器必须放置在顶面正中央。'

replacements.from: 'You will need two ports for inputting Deuterium'
'The Induction Matrix is used to store tons of Power.'
replacements.to: '输导矩阵用于储存海量电力。'

replacements.from: 'The Faces Can Be Either Casings Or Structural Glass.'
replacements.to: '各面可以是外壳或结构玻璃。'

replacements.from: 'Ports Can Be Changed Using A Configurator.'
replacements.to: '端口可使用配置器进行更改。'

replacements.from: 'Induction Cells Are Used To Increase Power Storage.'
replacements.to: '感应电池用于提高储能容量。'

replacements.from: 'Induction Providers Are Used To Increase Power Transfer Rate.'
replacements.to: '输导供应器用于提升电力传输速率。'

replacements.from: 'The Matrix Must Have One Cell and One Provider.'
replacements.to: '矩阵必须包含一个单元格与一个供应器。'

replacements.from: 'The SPS converts Polonium into Antimatter Gas using a large amount of power'
replacements.to: 'SPS通过消耗大量电力将钋转化为反物质气体。'

replacements.from: 'Ports Can Be Changed Using A Configurator'
replacements.to: '端口可使用配置器进行更改'

replacements.from: 'The SPS is built using this pattern for each face.'
replacements.to: '超临界移相器（SPS）需按此结构逐面搭建。'

replacements.from: 'On one side, you will need a Port in the middle to input power.'
replacements.to: '一侧需在中央放置一个端口以输入电力。'

replacements.from: 'On the inside, place a Supercharged Coil on the Port.'
replacements.to: '内部需在端口上放置一个增压线圈。'

replacements.from: 'You can also use two Supercharged Coils for max power usage.'
replacements.to: '也可使用两个增压线圈以实现最大电力消耗。'

replacements.from: 'You will need one Port for inputting Polonium.'

replacements.to: '还需要另一个端口来输出反物质气体。'

replacements.from: 'The Industrial Turbine uses Heated Coolant to create Power.'
replacements.to: '工业涡轮利用热冷却剂发电。'

replacements.from: 'The edges must be made of Turbine Casings.'
replacements.to: '边框必须由涡轮机外壳构成。'

replacements.from: 'The faces can be Turbine Casings, Structural Glass, Valves, or Vents.'
replacements.to: '各面可采用涡轮外壳、结构玻璃、阀门或排气口。'

replacements.from: 'Turbine Valves pump in Steam, or export Power.'
replacements.to: '涡轮阀门用于泵入蒸汽或输出电力。'

replacements.from: 'Turbine Rotors must be placed in the middle. Each Rotor uses 2 Turbine Blades.'
replacements.to: '涡轮转子必须放置在中央。每个转子消耗2个涡轮叶片。'

replacements.from: 'A Rotational Complex must be placed on top of the Turbine Rotor.'
replacements.to: '复杂旋钮装置必须放置在涡轮转子上方。'

replacements.from: 'Pressure Dispersers must fill the layer around the Rotational Complex.'
replacements.to: '分压元件必须填满围绕复杂旋钮装置的整层。'

replacements.from: 'Starting on this layer, Turbine Vents can be used for the outer faces. These also export Water from the Turbine.'
replacements.to: '从此层开始，外侧表面可使用涡轮排气口。这些排气口还可导出涡轮内的水。'

replacements.from: 'Electromagnetic Coils are placed on top of the Rotational Complex.'
replacements.to: '电磁线圈需放置在复杂旋钮装置顶部。'

replacements.from: 'A max of 5 can be placed. They either must connect to each other, or be touching the Rotational Complex.'
replacements.to: '最多可放置5个。它们必须彼此相连，或直接接触复杂旋钮装置。'

replacements.from: 'Saturating Condensers are used to convert Steam back into Water. These are not required, but must be placed on or above the Coil Layer.'
replacements.to: '饱和冷凝器用于将蒸汽重新转化为水。非必需，但必须放置在或高于线圈层。'

replacements.from: 'The Top Face can be replaced with Turbine Vents, if needed.'
replacements.to: '如需，顶面可用涡轮排气口替代。'
